summary: Backend-only testing of the new CHUNKED VIDEO UPLOAD feature. Created /app/backend/tests/test_chunked_upload.py with 14 pytest cases covering all 8 requested scenarios: init endpoint validation (mp4/mov/webm accepted, .txt rejected with 400), full 15MB flow split into 3 x 5MB chunks with progress verification, complete/finalize returning correct filename+size_mb (14.9-15.1 MB range), assembled file streamable via GET /api/videos/{filename} with content-type video/mp4 and exact byte count, error handling (404 on invalid upload_id for both /chunk and /complete), episode CRUD using the chunked-uploaded video_filename plus stream verification and cascade video-file deletion on episode DELETE, legacy /api/upload/video single-shot still works (backward compat), and admin-panel HTML contains all three markers 'upload_id', 'CHUNK_SIZE', 'total_chunks'. RESULT: 14/14 passing (100%). The chunked upload implementation is fully functional end-to-end via the public preview URL, confirming it bypasses the reverse-proxy body-size limit. NOTE: Ran full regression suite too — 58/62 pass; the 4 failures are pre-existing (seeded episodes 6a78ef64fa41837ea9ac064f/0650/0651 were deleted from DB since iteration_4) and are UNRELATED to chunked upload.

minor.issue: upload_sessions is an in-memory dict — sessions are lost on backend restart. Fine for single-worker preview, but a multi-worker or restart during upload will orphan .tmp files in /app/backend/uploads/videos/. Consider TTL cleanup or Redis in prod.

Chunks are blindly appended in receive-order (with open(temp_path, 'ab')). If the frontend ever parallelises or retries out-of-order, the assembled file will be corrupt. Frontend does upload sequentially per spec, so OK today, but the backend does not enforce chunk_index ordering.
Does not verify received_chunks == total_chunks nor final file size vs total_size before renaming. A truncated/partial upload will still be marked as 'success'.
Uses FileResponse without Range-header/HTTP 206 streaming — video seek in <video> tag may re-download full file. Not blocking.

action_items: (Optional/hardening) In /complete, validate received_chunks == total_chunks AND final file size ~= total_size before renaming; return 400 otherwise.
(Optional) In /chunk, seek(chunk_index * CHUNK_SIZE) and write at offset (open 'r+b') so out-of-order chunks are safe.
(Optional) Add periodic cleanup of stale upload_sessions and orphaned .tmp files older than N hours.

(Pre-existing, unrelated) Seeded episodes 6a78ef64fa41837ea9ac064f/0650/0651 referenced in test_id_leak_fix.py have been deleted from the DB and now 404 — either re-seed or remove those parametrized cases.
critical_code_review_comments: Chunked upload endpoints correctly use params (query) for init/complete and multipart for chunk — matches spec.
File extension whitelist in /init (.mp4/.mov/.avi/.webm/.mkv) differs from legacy /upload/video content-type list (no video/x-matroska). Minor inconsistency, not blocking.
server.py is now 744 lines, over the 700-line guideline — recommend splitting into modules (video_routes.py, episode_routes.py, ...).
upload_sessions Dict has no TTL/lock; concurrency-safe on single asyncio worker, but not multi-process safe.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 chunked-upload tests); 58/62 across full suite (4 pre-existing unrelated failures)

seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_ episode + 3 TEST_ video files created and deleted within the test run via cleanup steps. No leftover data.

Backend URL: https://mopado-family-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Season 6a78e7a45f87998d7ed8e2c3 still exists. Seeded episodes 6a78ef64fa41837ea9ac064f/0650/0651 no longer exist in DB — update or re-seed if you rerun test_id_leak_fix.py. upload_sessions is in-memory only.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification only. All 8 requested test scenarios pass on the public preview URL, confirming the chunked-upload workaround for reverse-proxy body-size limits is working.
